name: GeoFWI3D_UNETR_XY_D4_Dice_2CE_f0s0
objective: Improve final-budget validation Dice beyond 0.50 with one predeclared change
hypothesis: Increasing CE relative to foreground squared Dice may suppress false-positive salt predictions while retaining useful recall.

fixed.augmentation: xy_d4_v1, same transform and case sequence
fixed.loss: Foreground-only squared Dice + voxelwise unweighted CE
fixed.validation: Unaugmented native volumes, argmax, mean per-volume foreground hard Dice; no threshold tuning or TTA

budget.pre_execution_requirement: Verify new recipe arithmetic cost; floor(cap / measured update cost), never silently enlarge cap. Diagnostics separately logged under established convention.

gate.continue_if: mean validation Dice at 40% and 50% budget >= 0.46
gate.otherwise: Archive and stop; no automatic seed or hyperparameter sweep
gate.limitation: A cost-saving futility rule, not a validated predictor of final success; may reject a late improver.

bands_followup.trigger: Verified full-budget baseline final validation Dice > 0.50; no technical failure
bands_followup.initialization: Fresh identical original seed-0 initialization, not continued from the trained baseline
bands_followup.fixed: Exact successful baseline model, data split, augmentation/order, optimizer, learning-rate schedule and base loss
bands_followup.only_added_term: lambda * existing binary salt BANDS inner/outer boundary loss, 2-voxel 6-connected morphology on augmented training labels
bands_followup.calibration: Training-only gradient-RMS calibration against the actual successful base loss; target ratio 0.10, p95 cap 0.50; preserve calibration RNG; record lambda
bands_followup.compute: Remeasure BANDS cost; <= same cap per arm; report and budget calibration overhead explicitly; use fewer updates if required
bands_followup.comparison: Paired final-budget validation Dice delta, per-case deltas, FP/FN and salt-size quartiles; no claim of three-fold/three-seed consistency

alternatives_deferred.seed_sweep: Current failure has a specific systematic size/false-positive pattern
alternatives_deferred.higher_lr: Could improve short-budget fitting, but less directly targets observed errors
alternatives_deferred.more_augmentation_or_dropout: Already helped generalization; next change targets remaining precision deficit

prelaunch_checks: Correct augmentation-aware archive validator end-to-end, including completion/retirement
Resume identity and no duplicate updates
Conditional BANDS trigger must use final result and remain false at current 44.82%
